facts.activity_file: controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: provision and briefing of a competent fire watch

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: audit finding - critical control verification of critical control at K-7301

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch on K-7301, M-7301 and TT-7301 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining hazardous-area electrical equipment, specifically controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas. K-7301 (vapour recovery compressor) is in service for loading vapour recovery. The task proceeded during shift handover while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 25 January 2018 a planned critical control verification of K-7301, M-7301 and TT-7301 at Cape Verity Export Terminal found the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch not effective.
